item.description: Eating Through Kolkata: Five Kolkata Restaurants That Capture the City’s Evolving Food Culture From Park Street to Chowringhee Road, a curated guide to five Kolkata restaurants shaping the city’s contemporary dining culture.

item.title: Land Art Exhibit 'Infinity In A Box' Laid Bare The Hidden Cost Of Overconsumption
item.description: Ikshit Pande & Jasmeet Kaur Unbox The Himalayas Through Art 'Infinity in a Box' blends the beauty of the Himalayas with urgent reflections on climate change and overtourism, inviting both the local community and global visitors to co-create and reflect.
